elements_selected.content: Implement the zetl blocks <page> command (forward mode) per REQ-045 and CON-020. New subcommand BlocksArgs in cli.rs with: page: Option<String>, --type <TYPE> filter (heading/paragraph/spl/code/table/list/blockquote/frontmatter/all), --resolve <HASH> (mutex with page). Forward mode implementation in main.rs cmd_blocks: 1) Resolve page name using same case-insensitive wikilink matching as SPEC-001 §3.2, 2) Load the Merkle leaf data from the index cache (or re-index if stale), 3) For each leaf, output: index (0-based), type (with level for headings), lines [start, end], hash (hex BLAKE3), text (first 200 chars of normalised content), spl_hashes if SplBlock. JSON output matches CON-020 forward mode schema exactly, including file_hash and block_count at top level. Table output per CON-020 example. Apply --type filter before outputting. Exit code 0 on success, 1 if page not found. Require zetl index to have been run — if cache is stale or missing, auto-re-index first (consistent with other query commands).
